title: Compute Mie internal coefficients and radial integrals
action: For each size parameter α in {2, 4, 6, 8, 10} and refractive index n=1.33, compute the first-order internal Mie field coefficients c1 and d1 for circularly polarized plane-wave incidence using spherical Riccati-Bessel and Legendre functions (Barton et al. formalism). Also evaluate the radial integrals I1, I2, I3 defined in the analytic formula using the cosine integral Ci and Euler's constant. Save all intermediate results to 'mie_internal_data.csv'.
description: Intermediate evidence CSV containing Mie coefficients and radial integrals needed for the Q^ES calculation.
output_schema: Columns: alpha, c1_real, c1_imag, d1_real, d1_imag, I1, I2, I3. All numeric.

title: Compute electrostrictive force coefficient Q^ES
action: Read the intermediate data from 'mie_internal_data.csv'. For each α, compute the dimensionless hemisphere force coefficient Q^ES for the front hemisphere (positive sign) using the analytic formula that combines c1, d1 and I1, I2, I3. Write the results to 'q_es_values.csv'.
description: Scored CSV containing the computed electrostrictive force coefficient Q^ES for the front hemisphere at each specified α.
output_schema: Header: alpha, Q_ES. alpha: float, Q_ES: float (positive).
